Pursuant to Section 48-5-295 of the Official Code of Georgia, annotated relating to the term of office of members of the County Board of Tax Assessors and alloying the vacancies on such boards;

Be it resolved, by the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners that on and after July 1, 1996, each member of the Tax Assessors Board shall be appointed for a six (6) year term and until a successor is duly appointed and qualified.

The Board of Tax Assessors serving at present are: Donna Shurling whose term expires December 31, 1996, Vacant which term expires December 31, 1998,

Andrew Thompson whose term expires December 31, 1999.

Be it further resolved that any person appointed to fill a vacancy shall be appointed only to serve for the remainder of the unexpired term of office and shall possess the same qualifications required for regular appointments to a full term of office.

For qualifications for members see OCOG 48-5-29, 48-5-292.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed.

Adopted this 3rd day of December , 1996.
